source.prompt: Melodic house song, about 3.5 minutes, 123 BPM, D minor. Dreamy, euphoric evening-by-the-water mood with a gentle Brazilian warmth. Warm, soulful male lead vocal with soft layered harmonies on the chorus. Airy flute melody, harp arpeggios, lush string section swells, soft grand piano chords, rolling warm bass. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, shaker, congas and light bongos. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal, harp and strings, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, ooh, ooh

[Verse]
Paper boats on a silver river
Lamplight shaking in the evening air
I left my worries on the harbour wall
Followed the music, I don't know where

[Pre-Chorus]
Closer, closer, the night opens wide
Something is pulling me out with the tide

[Chorus]
I hear the slow tide calling
Calling my name across the bay
Stars on the water falling
Carry me further, far away
I hear the slow tide calling

[Verse]
Warm wind singing through the mango trees
Drums are rolling from a distant shore
Every heartbeat is a little lighter
Every wave is asking me for more

[Pre-Chorus]
Closer, closer, the night opens wide
Something is pulling me out with the tide

[Chorus]
I hear the slow tide calling
Calling my name across the bay
Stars on the water falling
Carry me further, far away
I hear the slow tide calling

[Bridge]
Let it go, let it flow
Into the blue where the lanterns glow
Let it go, let it flow
Only the ocean will ever know

[Chorus]
I hear the slow tide calling
Calling my name across the bay
Stars on the water falling
Carry me further, far away
I hear the slow tide calling
